The Planner failed to correctly extract the birth year (1929) from the text and instead hallucinated or misread the death year (1975) as the birth year. This fundamental data extraction error led to an incorrect understanding of the timeline, although the subsequent steps eventually corrected this specific number, the initial error in Step 1 was a clear failure to analyze the previous result accurately.
